description: Gestión Unidad de Mantenimiento Vial is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad Administrativa Especial de Rehabilitación y Mantenimiento Vial - UAERMV. El dato geográfico Gestión Unidad de mantenimiento vial, representa los segmentos viales que contienen el estado de la gestión adelantada por la Unidad de Mantenimiento Vial. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad Administrativa Especial de Rehabilitación y Mantenimiento Vial - UAERMV. Its tags are Eje vial, intervencion, priorización, segmento vial. It offers 5 resource(s) in ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ, SHP. The portal shows 2019-12-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
